meta.merge_rules: identity = the same agency reference AND the same agency binding (both agency names known and EQUAL after normalisation - case, punctuation, legal-form and business-type words, 'cyprus' - or an explicitly verified alias in scripts/agency_aliases.json; containment such as 'Acme Homes' vs 'Acme Homes International' is not a binding; a reference of any length or format never identifies on its own) AND no conflicting type/beds/village; or the same URL.
